summary: Called in to drop out: {party official} asks you to drop your primary challenge to {incumbent} and wait your turn.
realLife: In 1948 he challenged a fellow Republican, an isolationist congressman, in the primary, campaigning at factory gates, church socials and farms from a Quonset hut, and won.
gates: You filed in a primary against your own party's incumbent.
weights: How long {incumbent} has held the seat.
